column1: # The form of the tags that the datasource of each custom-manager pin (a "# renovate: datasource=...
# depName=..." comment) lists, as the pinned value has to be written for Renovate to match it. Read
# the datasource's public listing of the repository before adding an entry. scripts/check-renovate-pins
# fails for a pin whose value is not of the form, for a pin with no entry and for an entry with no pin.
# An entry for a dependency that Renovate reads from an action's inputs (jdx/mise) gives the form its
# version must have for Renovate to look its checksum up. A version of another form is held: where the
# step has a checksum Renovate moves nothing, and where it has none Renovate would move the version
# alone; both are moved by hand (.renovate/by-hand.tsv).
# Columns, separated by tabs: datasource, name, extended regular expression for the pinned value,
